summary: Full-stack testing of Ayojan Wale. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed (categories, event-types, ideas, vendors + filters + search + 404, event create+persist, lead create). Frontend: All requested flows work with real clicks - no overlay/pointer interception issue found. Homepage hero cards navigate correctly, category tiles pre-filter /vendors, Radix Select filters (category/city) update vendor-count, search+clear-filters work, vendor profile loads with packages + enquiry form POSTs to /api/leads with success toast, Plan wizard step1->step2->step3->submit produces plan-success and success-explore-vendors navigates to /vendors?event=wedding. Wizard validation shows toast 'Please name your event and pick an occasion' and stays on step 1.

issues: Console warning from Lenis: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Non-blocking but should set position on scroll container.
Sonner toast overlays right side of header nav (e.g., 'Inspiration' link partly hidden by toast). Consider moving toast position or increasing top offset.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Lenis console warning by making the scroll container position non-static.
(Optional) Reposition Sonner toaster so it does not overlap header nav links.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - should migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router; still works because middleware applies globally, but conventional order is before include_router.
No index on db.vendors fields used in queries (category_slug, event_types, city, name regex). For seed-scale it's fine; add indexes if data grows.
POST /api/leads does not validate vendor_id exists (accepts any string). Consider 404 if vendor not found.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds categories(11), event-types(8), vendors(14), ideas on startup. Test data created via API: TEST_Wedding event, TEST_User lead, TEST_Wedding_UI event.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No visual-edits overlay pointer interception detected via elementFromPoint(); real clicks navigate correctly. All data-testid attributes are in place. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_ayojan_api.py can be reused. If retesting, note that Radix Select options render in a portal - use [role='option'] selector.
